checks.message: Repository-provided provisional geometry is disclosed and does not block content scoring; it is not an official redline or a precision basis, and all affected quantities must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

All three required key areas use disclosed repository-provided provisional geometry; content review remains eligible, while approval, redline and precision-sensitive conclusions remain pending official polygons and full recalculation.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
